title: No AI judges your resume; a parser files it and a person searches
takeaway: The step that costs interviews is the silent parse, so fix what the parser extracts, then stop optimising for the machine.
sources: There is no AI reading your resume for potential.
This is the step that fails, and it fails silently.
Six to eight seconds per resume, in a list view.
The system parses and indexes; a person decides.
